long_biography.plain_text:
Ralph Dommermuth funded 1&1 Marketing with savings accumulated as a computer salesman. The firm initially organised marketing for software makers and later served major technology and telecommunications clients. As internet use grew, he replaced third-party marketing with proprietary services and took 1&1 public in Germany's first internet-company flotation.

The group was reorganised as United Internet and developed around internet access and applications, including 1&1, IONOS, GMX and WEB.DE. Beyond the business, Dommermuth co-founded United Internet for UNICEF and the Westerwelle Foundation, where he remains a board member supporting entrepreneurship in emerging markets. 1&1's Borussia Dortmund shirt sponsorship was a corporate marketing agreement; his charitable work is conducted through separate foundations.
long_biography.html:

The group was reorganised as United Internet and developed around internet access and applications, including 1&1, IONOS, GMX and WEB.DE. Beyond the business, Dommermuth co-founded United Internet for UNICEF and the Westerwelle Foundation, where he remains a board member supporting entrepreneurship in emerging markets. 1&1's Borussia Dortmund shirt sponsorship was a corporate marketing agreement; his charitable work is conducted through separate foundations.
